body.x: Moen unveiled a smart bathroom system ‘U’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

U, developed by Moen, is a smart device that can turn on and off the water, and set it to a specific temperature by controlling the system with voice, call and a controller. This device can save time by adjusting the length of shower time and temperature of the water, and is effective in saving water by precise start and pause. When the shower environment the user wants is set, an alarm will ring to make the user’s daily life much convenient.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
